---
title: "Reading"
---

## Recommended book

Solomons, Fryhle and Snyder, *Solomons' Organic Chemistry*, 12th Global
edition (2016), ISBN 9781119248972. The table shows which chapters go with
each part of the course. Chapter numbers differ between editions, so check
your copy's contents.

| Course part | Relevant Solomons chapters |
| --- | --- |
| Structures, properties, IR, acids/bases | 1–3 |
| Conformations and stereochemistry | 4–5 |
| Substitution, elimination and addition | 6–8 |
| Spectral structure determination | 9, with IR from chapter 2 |
| Alcohols and redox | 11–12 |
| Carbonyl addition and acyl chemistry | 16–17 |
| Aromaticity and amines | 14 and 20 |

Wiley provides a [Global edition contents listing](https://www.wiley.com/en-ie/shop/general-chemistry/solomons%27-organic-chemistry-global-edition-12th-edition-p-9781119248927).

## Free alternative

John McMurry's [*Organic Chemistry*, OpenStax](https://openstax.org/details/books/organic-chemistry)
is a free alternative for extra explanations. Its chapter numbering
differs from Solomons. For example, its
[resonance rules](https://openstax.org/books/organic-chemistry/pages/2-5-rules-for-resonance-forms)
and [acyl substitution discussion](https://openstax.org/books/organic-chemistry/pages/21-2-nucleophilic-acyl-substitution-reactions)
can support the corresponding course units.
